{"actions":[{"id":"a1","intent":"Replace select function to deduplicate by canonical identity keeping best score, sort descending and limit","new":"def select(rows, limit=5):

        sc=r.get("score",0)
        if k not in best or sc>best[k].get("score",0):best[k]=r
